requirements.title: FHIR R4 canonical pivot
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL use FHIR R4 as the canonical pivot.

requirements.title: CanonicalEnvelope shape
requirements.statement: SDK SHALL define a CanonicalEnvelope with payload + terminology + metadata.

requirements.title: Any-to-any translation

requirements.title: FHIR R4 base profile

requirements.title: FHIR R5 transition plan

requirements.statement: SDK SHALL emit WebSocket messages.
